title: Total Recall
description: A factory worker (Colin Farrell) becomes a hunted man after a procedure goes awry that would convert his dreams of life as a spy into real memories.

title: Alpha
description: Left for dead, a Cro-Magnon teen forms an unlikely alliance with a lone wolf that was abandoned by its pack. Facing overwhelming odds and nonstop danger, the boy and the wolf must now trek through a harsh landscape to make it home before winter.

title: The International
description: An Interpol agent (Clive Owen) and a New York prosecutor (Naomi Watts) join forces to shut down a powerful bank's funding of terrorism.
Students (Jim Sturgess, Kate Bosworth) from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology become experts at card-counting and use the skill to win big at Las Vegas casinos.

description: A young journalist (Billy Crudup) searches for the truth behind the tall tales told by his ailing father (Albert Finney).

title: Silverado

description: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.

title: Quicksilver
description: A hotshot stock-exchange floor trader (Kevin Bacon) loses his shirt and becomes a bicycle messenger in a hilly city.

description: A crook (Sean Connery) plans a caper with his Ivy League grandson (Matthew Broderick), with his son (Dustin Hoffman) in the middle.

title: Cold Comes the Night
description: A motel owner and her daughter are taken hostage by a blind thief to be his eyes while he tracks down his cash.

description: A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.

description: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

description: A psychiatrist (Jane Fonda) probes the mind of a nun (Meg Tilly) in whose room has been found a dead newborn infant.
